title: Invoice PDF render queue: a consumer that leaves jobs unfinished
name: Invoice render consumer

questions.prompt: The nightly invoice shutdown hook calls join() on the render queue so it can wait for in-flight work. Since the new templates went out, a few invoices end up in the dead-letter list every night and the deploy then hangs forever at shutdown, even though the queue looks empty. Fix jobs/consumer.py so the tests pass.

tests.content:
import threading
import unittest

from jobs.consumer import Consumer
from jobs.jobqueue import JobQueue
from jobs.models import RenderJob
from jobs.renderer import InvoiceRenderer

INVOICES = {"inv-1": ["x"] * 12, "inv-2": ["x"] * 65, "inv-3": ["x"] * 3}


def make(*jobs):
    q = JobQueue()
    results, dead = {}, []
    consumer = Consumer(q, InvoiceRenderer(INVOICES, {"standard", "compact"}), results, dead)
    for job in jobs:
        q.publish(job)
    return q, consumer, results, dead


class ConsumerTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_renders_every_queued_job(self):
        q, consumer, results, dead = make(RenderJob("j1", "inv-1"), RenderJob("j2", "inv-2"))
        self.assertEqual(consumer.drain(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(results["j2"].pages, 3)
        self.assertEqual(dead, [])

    def test_empty_queue_is_a_no_op(self):
        q, consumer, results, dead = make()
        self.assertEqual(consumer.drain(), 0)

    def test_bad_job_goes_to_dead_letters_with_reason(self):
        q, consumer, results, dead = make(RenderJob("j1", "inv-404"))
        consumer.drain()
        self.assertEqual(len(dead), 1)
        self.assertIn("inv-404", dead[0][1])

    def test_jobs_after_a_bad_job_are_still_rendered(self):
        q, consumer, results, dead = make(
            RenderJob("j1", "inv-1"), RenderJob("j2", "inv-1", template="gone"), RenderJob("j3", "inv-3")
        )
        self.assertEqual(consumer.drain(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(results), ["j1", "j3"])

    def test_every_taken_job_is_marked_done_even_when_it_fails(self):
        q, consumer, results, dead = make(
            RenderJob("j1", "inv-1"), RenderJob("j2", "inv-404"), RenderJob("j3", "inv-404", template="gone")
        )
        consumer.drain()
        print("pending:", q.pending(), "unfinished:", q.unfinished())
        self.assertEqual(q.pending(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(q.unfinished(), 0, "jobs were taken from the queue but never marked done")

    def test_join_returns_once_the_queue_is_drained(self):
        q, consumer, results, dead = make(RenderJob("j1", "inv-404"), RenderJob("j2", "inv-3"))
        consumer.drain()
        waiter = threading.Thread(target=q.join, daemon=True)
        waiter.start()
        waiter.join(timeout=1.0)
        self.assertFalse(waiter.is_alive(), "queue.join() is still blocked after the queue was drained")

    def test_clean_run_leaves_nothing_unfinished(self):
        q, consumer, results, dead = make(RenderJob("j1", "inv-1"), RenderJob("j2", "inv-3"))
        consumer.drain()
        self.assertEqual(q.unfinished(), 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
